jobs.title: AI Product Owner Director
jobs.description:
We’re building a relationship-oriented bank for the modern world. We need talented, passionate professionals who are dedicated to doing what’s right for our clients.

At CIBC, we embrace your strengths and your ambitions, so you are empowered at work. Our team members have what they need to make a meaningful impact and are truly valued for who they are and what they contribute.

To learn more about CIBC, please visit CIBC.com

What You'll Be Doing

As a Director, AI Product Owner within the Advanced Analytics Delivery, Artificial Intelligence team, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the direction of our AI product portfolio. You will own the prioritization and sequencing of a diverse backlog of operations use cases, ensuring the team is consistently focused on the most impactful and scalable solutions for the bank. Your day-to-day will involve translating business opportunities into actionable product decisions, maintaining a dynamic roadmap, and driving the reusability of AI assets across lines of business. You'll be the primary point of contact for stakeholders, communicating both capabilities and upcoming initiatives, and partnering with leadership to report on progress and strategic allocation. This role is not about project coordination—it's about setting vision, defining success, and making the calls that empower delivery teams to execute with confidence.

At CIBC we enable the work environment most optimal for you to thrive in your role. Details on your work arrangement (proportion of on-site and remote work) will be discussed at the time of your interview.

How You'll Succeed

Backlog Ownership & Prioritization – Continuously prioritize and sequence the operations use case backlog based on ROI, feasibility, and reusability, ensuring the team is focused on high-impact opportunities.
Product Requirements & Success Criteria – Translate stakeholder needs into structured product briefs and define clear success criteria for each use case.
Portfolio Road-mapping – Maintain an up-to-date product roadmap across all AI solutions, making it visible and actionable for leadership and team members.
Reusability & Asset Strategy – Identify and productize reusable components, models, and patterns to accelerate future delivery and maximize value.
Stakeholder Communication – Act as the external face of the AI portfolio, communicating capabilities and pipeline to operations stakeholders and guiding engagement.
Leadership Partnership – Collaborate with the Senior Director to report on portfolio progress, ROI realization, and capacity planning for leadership.

Who You Are

You can demonstrate 7+ years of experience in product management. You bring a track record of owning roadmaps and making strategic prioritization decisions in data, analytics, or AI environments.
You are technically fluent. You understand how AI solutions are constructed and can engage credibly with data scientists and ML engineers, even if you don’t build models yourself.
You look beyond the moment. You understand operations workflows. Ideally, you have deep familiarity with operations within financial services, enabling you to assess use cases for business value and AI feasibility independently. You are decisive and clear. You reduce ambiguity for your team by making informed decisions, documenting them, and moving forward efficiently.
You're passionate about people. You excel at stakeholder management and are comfortable presenting product strategies to senior leadership and translating feedback into actionable priorities.
You have a degree or diploma in Computer Science. Your educational background supports your technical and strategic expertise.
Values matter to you. You bring your real self to work, and you live our values - trust, teamwork, and accountability.

What CIBC Offers

At CIBC, your goals are a priority. We start with your strengths and ambitions as an employee and strive to create opportunities to tap into your potential. We aspire to give you a career, rather than just a paycheck.

We work to recognize you in meaningful, personalized ways including a competitive salary, incentive pay, banking benefits, a benefits program*, defined benefit pension plan*, an employee share purchase plan, a vacation offering, wellbeing support, and MomentMakers, our social, points-based recognition program.
Our spaces and technological toolkit will make it simple to bring together great minds to create innovative solutions that make a difference for our clients.
We cultivate a culture where you can express your ambition through initiatives like Purpose Day; a paid day off dedicated for you to use to invest in your growth and development.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Marketing Strategy
jobs.description:
Blend is a premier AI services provider, committed to co-creating meaningful impact for its clients through the power of data science, AI, technology, and people. With a mission to fuel bold visions, Blend tackles significant challenges by seamlessly aligning human expertise with artificial intelligence. The company is dedicated to unlocking value and fostering innovation for its clients by harnessing world-class people and data-driven strategy. We believe that the power of people and AI can have a meaningful impact on your world, creating more fulfilling work and projects for our people and clients. For more information, visit www.blend360.com.

Job Description

Why this role exists

Blend's marketing function has grown into a global operation that spans the full marketing funnel, from brand and market perception through demand and pipeline. We are looking for a senior marketing leader to partner with the Head of Global Marketing to drive impact.

Blend has a clear identity and a real point of view. This role takes that foundation and expands it. The goal is to make the story land harder in the markets we are going after and extend it into the categories and regions we are moving into next, with tangible impact on the business. That means shaping how we describe ourselves, holding the through-line across various areas that reach the market, and making sure the story is consistent whether it shows up in an analyst evaluation, a press release, a conference stage, or with our partners and clients.

That partnership will look different depending on the work. Some of it is collaboration: setting strategy together, pressure-testing decisions, working through team scalability. Some of it is trusted ownership: taking a set of priorities, being accountable for the outcome without needing to check in, and managing a team with driven execution.

The shape of this role will also evolve as the business does. Today the center of gravity sits in business storytelling: translating growth objectives into a narrative the market believes, and making sure it holds up wherever Blend is evaluated. Over time it is likely to expand into growth priorities like events, partner marketing, and demand.

Where you will have impact

Our approach is account-based. We put focused energy against a defined set of target accounts and named markets, which means the narrative, the campaigns, the events calendar, the partner motions, and the regional plans all have to point in the same direction. A meaningful part of this role is making that focus real — and keeping it disciplined when it would be easier to broaden.

Market narrative and strategic consistency

Sharpen how Blend describes itself in market, including category positioning, differentiation against the firms we compete with, and the through-line that connects our thought leadership
Own the messaging architecture that campaigns, events, sales enablement, executive communications, and partner materials all draw from
Establish the editorial standards and governance that keep the story consistent across regions, functions, and channels, and define what good looks like so the standard survives without you in the room
Serve as the editorial check on the work that carries the most reputational weight: press releases, analyst responses, executive bylines, and launch narratives
Ability to define success metrics, track and develop reporting that supports decisions made in this area and their expected or actual impact to the business.

Reputation and market perception

Own how the business storyline lands publicly — earned media, thought leadership, and executive visibility that put Blend's leaders in the conversations that shape our market
Guide the analyst relations approach alongside the Head of Global Marketing and the senior leadership team: which evaluations we pursue, what we say in them, and how we build durable standing with the firms that define our category
Turn client outcomes into credible, well-sourced proof that carries weight with buyers, analysts, and media

Growth capacity and planning

Partner with the Head of Global Marketing on the annual and quarterly plan, translating company growth priorities into sequenced, resourced marketing work
Own the measurement framework for your areas: what we are accountable for, how it is tracked, and how it gets reported to the executive team and the board
Bring rigor to investment decisions, including where to spend, where to stop, and what tradeoffs we are making
Build the growth capacity that makes the storyline usable — enablement, client-facing materials, and proof that moves an account conversation forward with sales and the client business units
Align the events calendar and partner motions to the same storyline and the same target accounts, so what a buyer hears from a stage, a partner, and our teams is one consistent story

Team leadership and global operating consistency

Lead a group of marketers spanning communications, content, design, and enablement, and grow the team as the plan requires
Coach senior individual contributors and managers, set performance expectations, and build a bench
Bring resources and operating consistency to the global teams that carry growth — shared knowledge, shared content, and reuse that compounds across regions instead of restarting in each one
Run the cadence that keeps a distributed global team aligned and engaged
Push the function's AI-native operating model forward, using the tooling and knowledge infrastructure the team is building rather than treating it as a side project

Qualifications

What we are looking for

We care more about demonstrated range than years on a resume. The strongest candidates will be able to point to specifics.

A track record of owning a significant piece of a marketing organization and being accountable for its results. We will want to hear what you were measured on, what you decided, and what happened
Depth in brand, corporate communications, or integrated marketing, with earned media experience and enough analyst relations exposure to hold your own with the firms in our category
Genuine editorial judgment. You can tell strong writing from filler, you can fix it yourself, and you can teach others to see the difference
Scope that has spanned multiple marketing disciplines, and comfort operating outside your deepest area of expertise
Fluency in the technology industry and how technical narratives can show up in market with accuracy, credibility and differentiation
Comfort in professional services, or a clear pattern of learning a new industry fast and earning credibility in it quickly
Experience managing marketers and hiring senior people
Executive presence with a CEO and senior leadership team, and the judgment to know when to decide and when to escalate
The temperament for a role that will change. Much of this work is bringing structure to things that do not have it yet, and the priorities will move as the business grows

Marketing leaders from professional services, B2B technology, SaaS, or the data and AI space are all plausible fits. What matters is the capability, not the pedigree.

What would set you apart

Experience within service-based business, technology industry and the partner-ecosystem; especially how service partners work with technology hyper scalers
Having built or scaled a marketing function through a growth or transaction cycle
Practical, hands-on use of AI in your own marketing work rather than a theoretical interest in it
Experience marketing across LATAM or EMEA, or working across languages and regional buying cultures
Experience with a rebrand, repositioning, or category-definition effort
Established relationships with Forrester, Gartner, Everest Group, or similar

Additional Information

The starting pay range for this role is $190,000 - $210,000. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent on several factors including but not limited to relevant experience, skills, certifications, training, and location. It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range and determining factors for compensation are considered for each individual circumstance. BLEND360 also offers a competitive benefits program to meet the health and financial well-being of our team and their families. You can look forward to a range of benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401K, PTO, paid holidays, commuter benefits, spending accounts, life insurance, disability coverage, and EAPs.

This role is for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of security, business strategy, manufacturing operations and technology — and who wants to see the concrete impact of their decisions on the ground, leading a lean team rather than a large one.

Lead cybersecurity and risk management

Own the organization's cybersecurity strategy, governance, and posture across Canada, Morocco and New Jersey — this is the top priority of the role.
Ensure compliance with ITAR, CMMC requirements and the NIST 800-171 standard in connection with defense-related activities.
Establish and maintain identity and access management practices, including Azure AD and Beyond Identity, with security as the primary lens.
Protect sensitive data and intellectual property, particularly in R&D, through strong data management, access control, and AI solution governance practices.
Lead incident response readiness, vulnerability management, and security awareness across the organization.
Evaluate and harden the security posture of collaboration and infrastructure tooling (Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, Ubiquiti, 3CX) in partnership with the help desk function.

Lead the transformation of enterprise applications

Lead the evolution of the EPICOR/Kinetic ERP for the Canada, Morocco and New Jersey sites, ensuring sustainable adoption, effective governance and measurable business results.
Simplify and modernize the application portfolio to eliminate redundancies and improve the flow of cross-functional processes.
Identify opportunities to optimize business and operational processes through automation, systems integration and continuous improvement.
Ensure rigorous management of partners, vendors and integrators in order to maximize quality, speed of execution, security, and return on technology investments.

Turn data and AI into business value, securely

Establish a data and artificial intelligence strategy that supports business priorities, manufacturing operations and the organization's growth — with strong working knowledge of AI deployment in both cloud and on-premises environments, and security as a first-order design constraint.
Define and implement a data governance framework covering ownership, quality, classification, security, compliance and responsible use of data, including data lake infrastructure.
Build BI, reporting and advanced analytics capabilities, including executive dashboards, operational metrics and self-service analytics tools.
Identify, prioritize and deploy concrete use cases in artificial intelligence, predictive analytics and intelligent automation to improve planning, production, quality, supply chain, customer service and decision-making.
Put measurement mechanisms in place to demonstrate the value generated by data, AI and automation initiatives, particularly in terms of productivity, cost, quality, lead times and adoption.

Own IT infrastructure, help desk, and collaboration tooling

Directly manage the Help Desk Manager, providing oversight of day-to-day support operations, ticket escalation, SLAs, and end-user satisfaction — with a security-conscious support culture.
Maintain strong working knowledge of the organization's collaboration and file-management stack — Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, and the full Microsoft Office 365 Admin Center.
Maintain working knowledge of network and communications infrastructure, including Ubiquiti and 3CX, to guide the help desk team and vendor relationships.

E2IP Technologies is looking for a Director, Cybersecurity, Digital Transformation, Applications, Data and Artificial Intelligence to play a key role in the organization's next phase of growth, modernization, and risk posture.

This is a unique opportunity for a strategic, engaging and pragmatic leader who thrives running a small, agile team hands-on. Reporting to the Vice-President, IT, you will take ownership of the organization's cybersecurity posture and governance first and foremost, alongside the evolution of our enterprise application ecosystem, our data strategy, our artificial intelligence capabilities, our core IT infrastructure and collaboration tooling, our help desk function, and our technology project portfolio across our sites in Canada, Morocco and New Jersey.

In particular, you will lead our cybersecurity and compliance program (including ITAR, CMMC, and NIST 800-171), the evolution of the EPICOR/Kinetic ERP, the development of our BI and analytics capabilities, and the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence — spanning both cloud and on-premises environments.

This role is for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of security, business strategy, manufacturing operations and technology — and who wants to see the concrete impact of their decisions on the ground, leading a lean team rather than a large one.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES :

Lead cybersecurity and risk management

Own the organization's cybersecurity strategy, governance, and posture across Canada, Morocco and New Jersey — this is the top priority of the role.
Ensure compliance with ITAR, CMMC requirements and the NIST 800-171 standard in connection with defense-related activities.
Establish and maintain identity and access management practices, including Azure AD and Beyond Identity, with security as the primary lens.
Protect sensitive data and intellectual property, particularly in R&D, through strong data management, access control, and AI solution governance practices.
Lead incident response readiness, vulnerability management, and security awareness across the organization.
Evaluate and harden the security posture of collaboration and infrastructure tooling (Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, Ubiquiti, 3CX) in partnership with the help desk function.

Lead the transformation of enterprise applications

Define and deliver the vision, strategy and roadmap for E2IP Technologies' application ecosystem, including the EPICOR/Kinetic ERP, EPM/BOARD, BI tools, CRM, integrations and related platforms — with security and compliance built in by design.
Lead the evolution of the EPICOR/Kinetic ERP for the Canada, Morocco and New Jersey sites, ensuring sustainable adoption, effective governance and measurable business results.
Simplify and modernize the application portfolio to eliminate redundancies and improve the flow of cross-functional processes.
Identify opportunities to optimize business and operational processes through automation, systems integration and continuous improvement.
Ensure rigorous management of partners, vendors and integrators in order to maximize quality, speed of execution, security, and return on technology investments.

Turn data and AI into business value, securely

Establish a data and artificial intelligence strategy that supports business priorities, manufacturing operations and the organization's growth — with strong working knowledge of AI deployment in both cloud and on-premises environments, and security as a first-order design constraint.
Define and implement a data governance framework covering ownership, quality, classification, security, compliance and responsible use of data, including data lake infrastructure.
Build BI, reporting and advanced analytics capabilities, including executive dashboards, operational metrics and self-service analytics tools.
Identify, prioritize and deploy concrete use cases in artificial intelligence, predictive analytics and intelligent automation to improve planning, production, quality, supply chain, customer service and decision-making.
Put measurement mechanisms in place to demonstrate the value generated by data, AI and automation initiatives, particularly in terms of productivity, cost, quality, lead times and adoption.

Own IT infrastructure, help desk, and collaboration tooling

Directly manage the Help Desk Manager, providing oversight of day-to-day support operations, ticket escalation, SLAs, and end-user satisfaction — with a security-conscious support culture.
Maintain strong working knowledge of the organization's collaboration and file-management stack — Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, and the full Microsoft Office 365 Admin Center.
Maintain working knowledge of network and communications infrastructure, including Ubiquiti and 3CX, to guide the help desk team and vendor relationships.
Linux experience preferred, given the mixed infrastructure environment.

Establish a high-value delivery discipline

Create and grow a lean, pragmatic and results-oriented IT PMO to improve demand management, prioritization, execution, governance and accountability.
Oversee the IT project portfolio and ensure initiatives are prioritized according to their business value, operational impact, security risk, and strategic alignment.
Lead major technology projects, taking ownership of scope, budget, timelines, quality, risks, vendors and change management.
Foster a transparent, disciplined and collaborative delivery culture focused on measurable results rather than simply putting solutions into production.

Build and lead a small, high-performing team

Lead, coach and develop a small, agile team spanning cybersecurity, applications, data, artificial intelligence, project delivery, and help desk/end-user support.
Manage and develop the Help Desk Manager directly, including goal-setting, coaching, and performance management.
Define the team's resourcing needs and build the business cases required to recruit and structure a team capable of supporting the company's security, growth, and analytics ambitions.
Develop the team's skills in cybersecurity practices, data governance, automation, advanced analytics, and responsible AI.
Create an environment of close collaboration between IT teams, business units and the various sites, particularly between Montreal and Morocco.

YOUR PROFILE :

What you bring

Demonstrated cybersecurity leadership experience — governance, risk management, incident response, and compliance frameworks — is the top priority for this role.
More than 12 years of progressive IT experience, including leadership responsibilities in enterprise applications, data, digital transformation and project delivery.
Working knowledge of ITAR and CMMC compliance and the NIST 800-171 standard is required, not just an asset.
At least 5 years of experience leading ERP implementations, with EPICOR/Kinetic experience strongly preferred.
Strong working knowledge of artificial intelligence, both cloud-based and on-premises, with demonstrated experience identifying, prioritizing and delivering AI, advanced analytics or process automation use cases — deployed with security in mind.

Experience managing a help desk or end-user support function, directly or through a direct-report manager.
PMP certification or an equivalent designation in project or program management.
Extensive experience in a discrete or process manufacturing environment. Previous experience in an engineering company is considered a strong plus.
Strong command of data governance, data lake infrastructure, Microsoft Fabric, BI platforms such as Power BI, and SQL.
Working familiarity with collaboration/file-management platforms (Egnyte, Box, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Admin Center) and identity management (Azure AD, Beyond Identity).

French/English bilingualism, both spoken and written.
Demonstrated experience managing external vendors, systems integrators and implementation partners.

CDMP certification or equivalent
Experience with enterprise artificial intelligence platforms, services or deployment frameworks

Previous experience working within an engineering company or engineering-driven organization
Knowledge of the BOARD EPM platform

Shape a real transformation: you will play a decisive role in modernizing the processes, systems and data that support the organization's operations.
